goal: Maintain peer counters at lifecycle transitions instead of per packet scans.
acceptance: Packet diagnostics do not scan peers.

workspace.reason: Isolated writer for shared package; NS-00 baseline preflight before dispatch

interfaces: Protocol v7; wire layout, fingerprints, runtime config v2 and public signatures frozen

Leaf ownership is limited to unigame.staticecs.network/Runtime/NetworkServer.cs, unigame.staticecs.network/Tests/Editor/NetworkV7DiagnosticsTests.cs. Aggregate candidate updates only listed gitlinks. Manager records and checks each nested immutable range before review.

Replace ActiveConnectionCount/ActivePeerCount scans only after tracing every AddConnection, Admit, direct Session.Close, CleanupPeer and disposal path. Counter updates must be correct before observer callbacks and idempotent across repeated cleanup.

Admission can transition Handshaking to Rejected before Close when epoch invalid; Ready send or observer failures can occur after Established. Cover those transitions without negative or leaked counts. Session state mutators are internal; public/wire signatures remain frozen.
Use existing diagnostics observer tests to assert actual emitted counters; no public counter API or per-packet rescan fallback.
tests: Packet diagnostics do not scan peers.

riskToTest.test: Focused EditMode regressions, complete Network/UTP/Movement/Prediction suites, MPPM and final harness
